expect.note: two identical live_planner calls explicitly send temperature 0 and therefore do not inherit the provider's sampling default

provenance: T-M40-5-3, reproduced again by ADR-041's post-change campaign on deployed build bfb2f395cfdf80c08636fb83ae5a5aee5aab6127: identical quotes reps produced one correct extraction and two adjacent-label failures; identical Open Library reps produced one correct extraction and two empty extracts. None of the twelve traces used a newly advertised action, so the 7/12 baseline to 5/12 result cannot evidence vocabulary behaviour and the within-build disagreement is classified as a flake. This case calls the real live_planner twice and replaces only its transport helper with a provider double that varies when sampling is implicit and holds still when temperature is zero. It neither retries nor selects a favourable completion.

triage.note: same build, task, URL and mode disagreed across adjacent fixed repetitions; mitigate the uncontrolled request parameter rather than rerunning the paid campaign until green
